svg.title: LoRA: learn a small update, keep the base frozen
svg.desc: The input passes through frozen base weights and a trainable low-rank A then B update in parallel. The outputs are added; B starts at zero, and the learned update can be merged into W after training.

g.text: x fans out to both paths
train only the small factors A and B
LoRA: learn a small update, keep the base frozen
Replace a full d × k update with two low-rank factors; merge the learned update back into W.
